question: Which machines have known-exploited vulnerabilities older than 30 days?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.name FROM findings f JOIN assets a ON a.id = f.asset_id JOIN finding_cves fc ON fc.finding_id = f.id JOIN kev k ON k.cve = fc.cve WHERE f.status = 'open' AND julianday('now') - julianday(f.first_seen) > 30 AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM fp_labels WHERE label = 'false_positive') AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM duplicates)

question: How many open critical findings are there?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM findings WHERE status = 'open' AND severity = 'critical' AND id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM fp_labels WHERE label = 'false_positive') AND id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM duplicates)

question: Which machines have more than 15 open findings?
sql: SELECT a.name FROM findings f JOIN assets a ON a.id = f.asset_id WHERE f.status = 'open' AND f.severity != 'info' AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM fp_labels WHERE label = 'false_positive') AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM duplicates) GROUP BY a.name HAVING count(*) > 15

question: List the CVEs on the CISA KEV list that are still open somewhere.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT fc.cve FROM finding_cves fc JOIN findings f ON f.id = fc.finding_id JOIN kev k ON k.cve = fc.cve WHERE f.status = 'open' AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM fp_labels WHERE label = 'false_positive') AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM duplicates)

question: Which open CVEs have a public exploit?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT fc.cve FROM finding_cves fc JOIN findings f ON f.id = fc.finding_id JOIN exploits e ON e.cve = fc.cve WHERE f.status = 'open' AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM fp_labels WHERE label = 'false_positive') AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM duplicates)

question: How many findings were fixed in the last 30 days?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM findings WHERE status = 'fixed' AND julianday('now') - julianday(fixed_at) <= 30 AND id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM fp_labels WHERE label = 'false_positive') AND id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM duplicates)

question: How many machines are there?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM assets

question: Which machines have no open critical findings?
sql: SELECT name FROM assets WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT asset_id FROM findings WHERE status = 'open' AND severity = 'critical' AND id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM fp_labels WHERE label = 'false_positive') AND id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM duplicates))

question: How many open critical findings are older than 15 days?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM findings WHERE status = 'open' AND severity = 'critical' AND julianday('now') - julianday(first_seen) > 15 AND id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM fp_labels WHERE label = 'false_positive') AND id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM duplicates)

question: Which machines have findings I marked as false positives?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.name FROM fp_labels l JOIN findings f ON f.id = l.finding_id JOIN assets a ON a.id = f.asset_id WHERE l.label = 'false_positive'

question: List the open CVEs with a CVSS score of 9 or higher.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT fc.cve FROM finding_cves fc JOIN findings f ON f.id = fc.finding_id JOIN cves c ON c.cve = fc.cve WHERE f.status = 'open' AND c.cvss_score >= 9 AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM fp_labels WHERE label = 'false_positive') AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM duplicates)

question: How many different CVEs are open across all machines?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT fc.cve) FROM finding_cves fc JOIN findings f ON f.id = fc.finding_id WHERE f.status = 'open' AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM fp_labels WHERE label = 'false_positive') AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM duplicates)

question: Which machines have open findings for CVEs known to be used in ransomware?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.name FROM findings f JOIN assets a ON a.id = f.asset_id JOIN finding_cves fc ON fc.finding_id = f.id JOIN kev k ON k.cve = fc.cve WHERE f.status = 'open' AND k.ransomware = 'Known' AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM fp_labels WHERE label = 'false_positive') AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM duplicates)

question: How many open findings does fake-web-01 have?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM findings f JOIN assets a ON a.id = f.asset_id WHERE a.name = 'fake-web-01' AND f.status = 'open' AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM fp_labels WHERE label = 'false_positive') AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM duplicates)

question: Which CVEs are open on more than 3 machines?
sql: SELECT fc.cve FROM finding_cves fc JOIN findings f ON f.id = fc.finding_id WHERE f.status = 'open' AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM fp_labels WHERE label = 'false_positive') AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM duplicates) GROUP BY fc.cve HAVING count(DISTINCT f.asset_id) > 3

question: Which scanners have reported findings?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT scanner FROM findings

question: Which open CVEs have a latest EPSS score above 0.5?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT fc.cve FROM finding_cves fc JOIN findings f ON f.id = fc.finding_id JOIN epss_history e ON e.cve = fc.cve WHERE f.status = 'open' AND e.date = (SELECT max(date) FROM epss_history WHERE cve = fc.cve) AND e.epss > 0.5 AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM fp_labels WHERE label = 'false_positive') AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM duplicates)

question: How many open high-severity findings are on fake-dev machines?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM findings f JOIN assets a ON a.id = f.asset_id WHERE a.name LIKE 'fake-dev-%' AND f.status = 'open' AND f.severity = 'high' AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM fp_labels WHERE label = 'false_positive') AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM duplicates)

question: Which CVEs were added to the KEV list in the last 90 days and are open on my machines?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT fc.cve FROM finding_cves fc JOIN findings f ON f.id = fc.finding_id JOIN kev k ON k.cve = fc.cve WHERE f.status = 'open' AND julianday('now') - julianday(k.date_added) <= 90 AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM fp_labels WHERE label = 'false_positive') AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM duplicates)

question: What is the weakness type (CWE) seen most often among open findings?
sql: SELECT c.cwes FROM finding_cves fc JOIN findings f ON f.id = fc.finding_id JOIN cves c ON c.cve = fc.cve WHERE f.status = 'open' AND c.cwes IS NOT NULL AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM fp_labels WHERE label = 'false_positive') AND f.id NOT IN (SELECT finding_id FROM duplicates) GROUP BY c.cwes ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
